REGISTRY DEVIATION, recorded: the kit's minio provider fragment pins `minio/minio:RELEASE.2024-10-13T13-34-11Z` on Docker Hub. That repository now refuses an anonymous manifest read (HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED, reproduced three times and confirmed by `docker manifest inspect`), so an unauthenticated build cannot pull it. The same release tag is served anonymously from MinIO's own registry at `quay.io/minio/minio`, and that is what `environment/docker-compose.yaml` pins, digest included. Everything else in the fragment -- the command, the root identity, the private bucket created once by a parked `minio-init` -- is carried verbatim.
